name: Momen
source:
A human of unknown gender who was raised as a trustee of "Mother". They carry the blood of a curse that seals away demons, and they have no choice but to obey.

They are a peaceful and tolerant cleric. They don't even know the gender they were born as.

[From the [url=https://maduzudz.wixsite.com/marutoku/marblingclear]official[/url] [url=https://nemurita.wixsite.com/nemuritai/metostareclipse]websites[/url]]
